Modules
fields.description: Switch whole areas of the CRM on or off for everyone. A switched-off module disappears from the menu and its data stops being served.

fields.label: Customer page
fields.description: One page per customer: their orders, prices, contracts and every conversation, in one place.

fields.label: Leads
fields.description: Capture new enquiries and follow them until they become opportunities or customers.

fields.label: Opportunities
fields.description: Track deals being worked on, and what stage each one has reached.

fields.label: Prospects
fields.description: Group the leads and opportunities that belong to one potential customer company.

fields.label: Mail
fields.description: Read and send email from inside the CRM, filed against leads and customers.

fields.label: Calls
fields.description: Log phone calls against leads and customers, and see who called whom.

fields.label: Events & Tasks
fields.description: Meetings, visits, calendars and follow-up tasks.

fields.label: Activity log
fields.description: A running list of everything that changed across the CRM.

fields.label: Campaigns
fields.description: Email campaigns: who is enrolled, what was sent, and how it went.

fields.label: Sales analytics
fields.description: Funnel, conversion and revenue charts for sales management.

fields.label: Reports
fields.description: Ready-made reports you can run, filter and export.

fields.label: Territories
fields.description: A world map of where customers, claims and sales are.

fields.label: Correspondence
fields.description: Which staff member is in touch with which customer, from real email traffic.

fields.label: Claims
fields.description: Log complaints and quality claims against customers and orders, and track them to resolution. (Coming soon.)

fields.label: Quotations
fields.description: Quotations sent to customers and prospects, and which ones turned into orders. (Coming soon.)

fields.label: Visits
fields.description: Farm visits by customers and customer visits by sales staff, with outcomes and follow-ups. (Coming soon.)

fields.label: Customer Page Tabs
fields.description: One per line, in the order shown. Any of: overview, timeline, orders, pricing, contracts.

fields.label: Theme — Brand Colours
fields.description: Every theme field is optional. Blank means the CRM works the colour out for you from the others; with nothing set at all, the CRM looks exactly as shipped.

fields.label: Accent
fields.description: Your brand colour. Used for highlights, badges, charts and the focus ring.

fields.label: Accent Dark
fields.description: A deeper version of your brand colour, for brand-coloured text on white and the dark end of buttons. Blank = worked out from Accent.

fields.label: Accent Soft
fields.description: A very pale version, used behind highlighted badges and selected rows. Blank = worked out from Accent.

fields.label: Use Accent For Main Buttons
fields.description: Off: main buttons are near-black and your brand colour is just trim. On: buttons, the focus ring and the active menu item use your brand colour.

fields.label: Ink
fields.description: The main text colour. It also tints every grey and every shadow, so this one choice changes the feel of the whole app.

fields.label: Muted Text
fields.description: Secondary text like dates, labels and hints. Pick a warm or cool grey to set the mood.

fields.label: Page Canvas
fields.description: The background behind all the cards.

fields.label: Muted Fill
fields.description: Slightly darker patches: row hover, quiet panels, the search box. Blank = worked out from Canvas.

fields.label: Border
fields.description: Thin lines around cards, inputs and between table rows. Blank = worked out from Canvas.

fields.label: Border Strong
fields.description: Heavier dividers and the edge of outlined buttons. Blank = worked out from Canvas.

fields.label: Theme — Status Colours
fields.description: Each one also makes its own pale badge background.

fields.label: Success
fields.description: Good news: won deals, paid invoices, completed tasks.

fields.label: Warning
fields.description: Needs attention: overdue tasks, pending quotations.

fields.label: Danger
fields.description: Problems: lost deals, failed messages, errors.

fields.label: Info
fields.description: Neutral notes and secondary chart lines.

fields.label: Theme — Fonts
fields.description: Bundled fonts need no internet connection. Choose Custom to use any Google font — give its family name and the stylesheet link.

fields.label: Theme — Corners
fields.description: How rounded things are. A size like 8px or 0.5rem, or 0 for square corners.

fields.label: Small Corners
fields.description: Buttons, inputs and badges. Blank = 12px.

fields.label: Card Corners
fields.description: Cards, KPI tiles and tables. Blank = as shipped.

fields.label: Panel Corners
fields.description: Dialogs, the sidebar and large panels. Blank = as shipped.
